project.title: 文案不是成片 — dark-technical / data-viz 样片

scenes.visualSubject: Dark technical grid backdrop with headline lockup 文案不是成片 and subtitle 从观点到知识动画

beats.action: kicker // BUILD 01 slides in from left
headline 文案不是成片 rises in with accent em on 成片
accent baseline sweeps in under lockup

scenes.finalState: Full headline lockup readable for 1.0s before hard-cut

scenes.narration: 你负责把观点讲清楚，Skill 负责把逻辑变成观众看得懂的画面。

beats.action: chart title and unit label enter
muted gridlines then baseline axis draw in (axis before data)
bars grow with scaleY from baseline, stagger 0.12 (100 / 38 / 86)

non-key bars dim to 0.35, key bar 观众理解 pulses once in accent
plot drifts gently as narration breathes; hold

scenes.finalState: Dimmed bars with accent key bar and note readable for 1.0s

scenes.narration: 真正难的，是把观点变成画面。

beats.action: payoff word 观点 lands on spoken 难
accent word 画面 lands; underline track sweeps
grid brightens slightly; final state fades and holds to 10.4

scenes.finalState: Responsibility cards plus 观点→画面 payoff hold for 1.0s
